G0745.name: Archelaus
G0745.desc: Ethnarch living at the time of the New Testament
G0745.brief: Son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch of Judea
G0745.short: Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, Ethnarch over Judea, causing Joseph to fear returning there with Mary and the child Jesus.

G0751.name: Archippus
G0751.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0751.brief: Fellow soldier and minister in Colossae
G0751.short: Archippus, addressed as a fellow soldier by Paul, was urged to complete the ministry he had received in the Lord.

G0702.name: Aretas
G0702.desc: King living at the time of the New Testament
G0702.brief: King of the Nabataeans in Damascus
G0702.short: Aretas, the king of the Nabataeans, governed Damascus and tried to arrest Paul.

G0708.name: Aristarchus
G0708.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0708.brief: Macedonian companion of Paul, fellow prisoner
G0708.short: Aristarchus, a Macedonian from Thessalonica, was a faithful companion of Paul during his missionary journeys and imprisonment.

G0711.name: Aristobulus
G0711.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0711.brief: Believer in Rome, greeted by Paul
G0711.short: Paul sends greetings to those who belong to the household of Aristobulus, suggesting that Aristobulus was a prominent believer in Rome.

G0734.name: Artemas
G0734.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0734.brief: Companion of Paul, potential replacement for Titus
G0734.short: Artemas was a companion of Paul who could potentially replace Titus in Crete (<ref="Titus 3:12">Titus 3:12</ref>).

G0799.name: Asyncritus
G0799.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G0799.brief: Believer in Rome greeted by Paul
G0799.short: Asyncritus was a believer in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings (<ref="Rom.16.14">Rom.16.14</ref>).

G0773.name: Asia
G0773.brief: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.
G0773.short: Asia, a Roman province in western Asia Minor, with Ephesus as its capital.

G0789.name: Assos
G0789.brief: A seaport in Mysia, visited by Paul.
G0789.short: Assos, a seaport in Mysia where Paul met his companions during his third missionary journey.

G0735.name: Artemis
G0735.brief: Greek goddess worshipped in Ephesus, associated with fertility
G0735.short: Artemis, a Greek goddess worshipped in Ephesus, was the focus of a major controversy during Paul's ministry in the city (<ref="Act.19.24, 27, 28, 34, 35">Act.19.24, 27, 28, 34, 35</ref>).
